Name: Stardew Cocktails
Author: AxelotlTheGreat
Description:
Description
Adds more than 30 new cooking recipes for drinks, and adds 6 new keg products, gin from juniper (New crop),vodka from high-quality potatoes, cider from apples, rum from sugar cane (New crop), whiskey from rye (New crop), tequila from cactus fruit, and bourbon from corn.

Installation instructions
1. Click the download button.
2. Unzip the file
3. Drag the folder to the mods folder.

Main features
- 6 new keg products.
- 6 new crops.
- More than 30 new cooking recipes.
- 1 new machines and 7 new products from it.

Requirements
- Stardew Valley 1.6
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher
Shout outs
Shout out to my dad @dhfraser for helping me with this mod, and my brother @LionEagle15 for the sprites.
